What's your standard NDA process?

Our standard NDA process is quite efficient. We use a mutual NDA as our standard, and we typically sign it before any technical discussions or data sharing begin. Here is how it works: First, you can send your NDA to legal@smallest.ai, or we can send you our standard template. One of our legal team members, Manjari, will review it. If there are any edits, she will send you a version with tracked changes. Once we agree on the final text, our CTO, Akshay, will sign it, and then you can counter-sign. We aim to have the NDA executed within one week of initiation. Does that sound good to you?
How long does it typically take?

We aim to have the NDA executed within one week from when we receive your request. The legal review itself typically takes about two business days. So, once you send the NDA to us, we'll get it to you for signature within that timeframe. Does that work for your schedule?
Who would be the signatory from your side?

Our CTO, Akshay, is the primary signatory for NDAs. He handles these directly to keep the process moving quickly. Would you like me to send our standard NDA template to you now so you can start the review?
Great, we'll send our template to legal@smallest.ai. Thanks.
Thank you, Ravi. We'll look out for that template at legal@smallest.ai. Have a great day!

scenarios.name: MSA clause questions — liability and data

transcript.text: Hi, I'm reviewing the MSA terms for Smallest AI. I have a few questions.
Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Desk at Smallest AI. How can I help you with your legal process today?
I can certainly help with that. What specific questions do you have about the MSA terms?
What's your standard position on liability caps?
Our standard position is that liability is capped at the fees paid by the client in the preceding 12 months. We do not accept unlimited liability.
And what about data processing? Do you use our data for training?
No, we do not use customer data to train our models. We process your data strictly for the delivery of the service.
We need unlimited liability for data breaches. Is that possible?
I cannot agree to unlimited liability. For any modifications to our standard terms, please reach out to Manjari at legal@smallest.ai, and she can connect you with our legal team for review.

Great, I can help with that. To get this started, could you please share your company name?
Do you have ISO certification?

Yes, we have ISO 27001 certification, which is currently valid. We can share the certificate directly. To get the full vendor registration package sent over to you, could you please share your company name?
We also need your GST and PAN details.

We can definitely provide those. The legal team can send over the complete vendor registration package, which includes the GST and PAN details, along with the other documents I mentioned. To make sure it goes to the right place, could you please share your company name?
How quickly can you send all this?
The legal team can compile and send the package within 2 business days once we have your company name. Could you please share your company name so I can get this started for you?

scenarios.name: Indian bank asks about Aadhaar E-Sign

transcript.text: We use Aadhaar-based E-Sign for all vendor NDAs. Can Smallest AI support that?
Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Assistant for Smallest AI. I can help you with NDAs, MSAs, or vendor registration. How can I assist you today?
What signatory details do we need from your side for E-Sign?
Yes, we absolutely support Aadhaar-based E-Sign for Indian banking clients. You can send the NDA to legal@smallest.ai
For E-Sign, we typically require the signatory's Aadhaar number, mobile number, and a One-Time Password (OTP). We can also use a DocuSign or Adobe Sign link if that works better for your team.
